# GET /api/v1/users/{username}

Get a user's public profile information

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none (optional, affects visibility) · **ID:** `ep-124`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — api.User

| Field | Type | Description |

| `id` | int64 | User ID |
| `login` | string | Username |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| User profile visibility check: private users are only visible to admins, self, followers, or org co-members | authorization | u.Visibility == VisibleTypePrivate |
| When user is not visible, return 404 with fake ErrUserNotExist to prevent information leakage | authorization | !user_model.IsUserVisibleToViewer(ctx, ctx.ContextUser, ctx.Doer) |
| Private fields (is_admin, login_name, source_id, last_login, language, is_active, prohibit_login) only shown when authed (self or admin) | business_logic | authed (doer.ID == user.ID || doer.IsAdmin) |
| Email is hidden when user has KeepEmailPrivate=true, unless viewer is authed (self or admin) | business_logic | signed && (!user.KeepEmailPrivate || authed) |
